edits.before_quote: The creature takes double damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn, unable to use actions, reactions, or free actions. At the end of its turn, it may attempt another Fortitude save; on a success the incapacitation ends.
edits.after_quote: The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned} until it succeeds at a Fortitude save, which it can attempt at the end of each of its turns.
edits.corpus_citation: apps/codex/data/corpus/condition/stunned.json: "You've become senseless. You can't act." — confirms Stunned is the correct named-condition target for the bespoke "can't act" state. apps/codex/data/corpus/creature/ankylosaurus@legacy.json: "...it's stunned until the end of its next turn" — official precedent for bare Stunned (no value) + 'until X' duration idiom. apps/codex/data/corpus/spell/darkened-eyes.json (Core Rulebook, official): "...the target is also [blinded] for the duration. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns. If it succeeds, it's no longer blinded..." — official precedent for the repeat-save-to-end-each-turn structure paired with a named condition. apps/assay/vendor/run_balance/base_spells_5e/gen_homebrew.json (Gravity Anvil, 5e original): "An incapacitated creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns; a successful save ends the incapacitation" — confirms the repeat-save structure is the faithful 5e carry, which the rewrite preserves.
edits.notes: Stakeholder ratified Stunned over Paralyzed 2026-07-26 (see ledger below). Register choice deliberately weaker than the source's plain no-action-except-Recall-Knowledge framing per the stakeholder's own reasoning. No structural-field lockstep needed: system.duration.value stays "varies", system.heightening/traits untouched, neither references the incapacitation wording.

edits.before_quote:
As failure, but the target also takes a -2 status penalty to Reflex saves for the duration, and the initial Will save at the end of each of its turns is not granted. Instead, the target must succeed at two consecutive Will saves (one at the end of a turn and one at the start of the next) before the effect ends.

Heightened (6th) The penalty to Reflex saves on a critical failure increases to -3, and the spell also imposes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} on a critical failure for the duration.
edits.after_quote:
As failure, but the target also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} for the duration, and the initial Will save at the end of each of its turns is not granted. Instead, the target must succeed at two consecutive Will saves (one at the end of a turn and one at the start of the next) before the effect ends.

Heightened (6th) On a critical failure, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 2} instead of Clumsy 1.
edits.corpus_citation: sweep-brief-v3.md T8: "...Dex-based -> Clumsy... Earlier-review exemplar: 'It becomes Clumsy 1 and takes a -1 status penalty...' replacing a bespoke stack." apps/assay/homebrew/spells/fast-forward.json is the in-store exemplar for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy N} reference format, mirrored verbatim here.
edits.notes: Contingent fix applied per CARDS.md:383 disposition: base -2/-3 Reflex penalty -> Clumsy 1/2 (T8's calibrated Dex exemplar); the Heightened(6th) tier's separate +Clumsy-1 stack (same status-penalty type, does not stack per PF2e rules) collapses into a single Clumsy 2 result on the crit-fail tier, exactly as the ratified card specifies (CARDS.md P3 card + row-383 disposition: 'the crit-fail tier resolves to a single Clumsy 2'). Escape-valve/movement-trigger mechanics (commit f2bccfe) untouched -- not in the edited spans.

edits.before_quote:
The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute and takes a –2 status penalty to attack rolls and Strength-based skill checks. At the end of each of its turns, the affected creature can attempt a new Fortitude save; on a success, the effect ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute and the status penalty increases to –3.
edits.after_quote:
The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 2}. At the end of each of its turns, the affected creature can attempt a new Fortitude save; on a success, the effect ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 3} instead.
edits.corpus_citation: apps/assay/homebrew/spells/fast-forward.json Failure/Critical-Failure lines ("...becomes Enfeebled 2 and Clumsy 2..." / "...Enfeebled 3 and Clumsy 3 instead...") are the stakeholder-ratified Card-2 exemplar this mirrors exactly, including the crit-fail one-step-up-on-both-conditions scaling.
edits.notes: Both the Str axis (attack rolls + Str-based skill checks -> Enfeebled) and the previously-dropped Dex axis (per CARDS.md:882, the store had silently dropped the 5e original's Dexterity-based-check penalty -> Clumsy) are restored via the joint Enfeebled+Clumsy mapping, per CARDS.md:886 disposition ("the joint card should decide whether to apply Enfeebled + Clumsy together... instead of a flat, Str-only status penalty"). Existing Slowed 1/2 values and the 1-minute duration are untouched, exactly as scoped. Zero change to anything else: the T6 dropped-Dash-exhaustion clause (CARDS.md:877/880, no prior ruling, a separate open CARD) was left alone -- see skips. Heightened(+2) radius line untouched (DIGEST already confirmed non-bloat, unrelated to T8).
